title: Hostinger coupon: you don't need one, and here is what the referral link gives
seoTitle: Hostinger Coupon 2026: 20% Off First Period, No Code
description: Does Hostinger have a coupon? You don't need one. The referral link gives 20% off the first period of a new plan, with no code to type. See which services qualify, what the terms say and what changes at renewal.
metaDescription: There is no code to type at Hostinger: the referral link gives 20% off the first period of a new plan, does not stack with other coupons, and renewal goes back to the standard price.
imageAlt: The OpenClaw, Hermes Agent and Paperclip logos, with the Hostinger logo, the 20% discount and a link icon

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: You don't need a Hostinger coupon: the [Hostinger referral offer](/en/coupons/hostinger) has no code to type, because the discount is already in the link. A new plan gets 20% off the first period only, and renewal goes back to the standard price. What the discount is worth depends on the period you choose; see How the discount works.

contentSections.heading: What Hostinger says about coupons
paragraphs: Most searches for a Hostinger coupon end in a code that does nothing, because the company rarely works with codes. In its Black Friday FAQ, Hostinger states that no coupon code is needed for its main offers: the discounts are applied automatically on the page. The same FAQ warns that some promotions for specific channels may use separate codes.
This text covers one thing only: the referral link, which is how this site's discount works. We don't cite codes from other sites, and you don't need any to get the discount described here.

contentSections.heading: Where the code goes
paragraphs: Nowhere. The referral code is already in the link, so you don't type anything at checkout. The link opens Hostinger's pricing page with the discount applied; when we opened it on October 24, 2026, each plan card showed the notice “Referral code applied”. For a summary of the offer, see the [Hostinger page here on the site](/en/coupons/hostinger).

contentSections.heading: How the discount works
paragraphs: Hostinger's referral page says the 20% applies to the first period of any new plan, whatever the product. The discount is calculated on the campaign price in effect at the time, so the final price depends on your region and on the promotion running when you buy. That is why this text lists no prices: the page you reach through the link shows the current ones.

The period you choose is what changes the math. The 20% comes off the first period as a whole, so a long first period means a bigger total discount, and a short one means a smaller discount and an earlier renewal at the standard price.

The programme terms are narrower than the page. They limit the eligible services, refer to subscriptions of 12 months or more, and say “up to 20%” where the page says 20%. For that reason this text does not promise the discount on every plan: check in the cart whether the 20% appears on the plan you chose.
For the Black Friday campaign, with its dates and the comparison between the promotion and the link, see the [Hostinger Black Friday guide](/en/reviews/hostinger-black-friday).

contentSections.heading: Renewal: what changes after the first period
paragraphs: After the first period, the plan renews at the standard price, shown below each plan's card on the pricing page. Renewal has no discount. The page says you can change the billing period or cancel at any time before renewal.

To turn off automatic renewal, and to see what customers say about charges they did not expect, read the [Hostinger on Trustpilot article](/en/reviews/hostinger-trustpilot-reviews), which has the step by step from Hostinger's help center.

contentSections.heading: Why the discount doesn't stack with another coupon
paragraphs: The FAQ on the referral page says this is already the best price Hostinger can offer through the link, and that other discount coupons do not stack with it. If you find a code on another site, it will not add to the 20%. We don't recommend any.

contentSections.heading: Which services qualify: hosting, VPS, email and domain
paragraphs: The programme terms list website hosting, VPS and Hostinger email among the eligible services. Domains are not on that list, so we don't count on the 20% for a domain; what counts is what appears in the cart.
The page also doesn't use the term “first purchase”. Its rule is the first period of a new plan, which matters if you plan to add a second product later.

contentSections.heading: Existing customers
paragraphs: The link does not apply to renewals or to purchases already made. The terms describe the programme as aimed at new users, and the page does not say what Hostinger offers existing customers, so this text does not promise a renewal discount. If you already have a plan, check the renewal price in your Hostinger control panel.

contentSections.heading: Our experience with Hostinger
paragraphs: This site runs on Hostinger. Bruno, who also signs this text, has been a customer since 2024, for more than 24 months: Business web hosting, a KVM 2 VPS, Business email and domains, all with automatic renewal. Every time there was a problem, support solved it, mainly through the AI agent, and he has never seen the service go down.
That is his account, with his use. The discount rules in this text come from Hostinger's referral page and programme terms, not from his experience.

contentSections.heading: Is the referral link worth it?
paragraphs: Our reading: for a new plan, yes. The link costs nothing to use, there is no code to get wrong, and 20% off the first period is more than a coupon from another site would give, because those don't stack. The two things that decide how much you save are the period you choose and the renewal price, so check both before you pay:
bullets: Open the link using this article's button.
On the pricing page, look for the notice that the referral code was applied, and compare the first-period total with and without the link.
In the cart, check that the 20% appears on the first period and that the renewal price is listed. The page does not say whether the account must be new, so this is the moment to confirm.
If the cart price differs from what you saw elsewhere, the cart price is the one that counts. Prices change with the campaign and with your region.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Does Hostinger have a coupon? No need. The 20% discount is already in the referral link, on the first period of a new plan.
Does the referral link discount renewal? No. Renewal goes back to the standard price, shown below each plan's card.
Does the discount stack with another coupon? No. The page says other discount coupons do not stack with the link.
Does a domain qualify for the discount? The terms don't list domains among the eligible services. Check the cart before paying.
Do existing customers get the discount? The page's rule excludes renewals and purchases already made. To renew, check the price in your Hostinger control panel.

contentSections.heading: Transparency note
paragraphs: This is a referral article. Purchases made through the link may earn Hostinger credit for Bruno, at no extra cost to the buyer. This site runs on Hostinger, and Bruno has been a customer since 2024. The referral page, its FAQ and the programme terms were read on October 19, 2026. Prices and campaigns change, and Hostinger can change them at any time.
